data.description: MQ live-validation run (2026-06-03) surfaced repo-wide '##[warning]Node.js 20 actions are deprecated' on actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-python@v5, actions/upload-artifact@v4. GitHub forces Node 24 on 2026-06-16 and removes Node 20 on 2026-09-16. Repo-wide (every job using these actions). Verify the latest stable major versions against the actions' release notes (do not guess) and bump across all .github/workflows/*.yml. Not MQ-specific; separate from ADR-0019. Interim opt-in available via FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true.
data.title: Bump deprecated Node.js 20 GitHub Actions (checkout/setup-python/upload-artifact) before 2026-06-16 forced cutover
